prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 4.06 °C/min (926% above healthy); TS4 mean temperature 59.0 °C (90% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 62.0 °C (72% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 6.44 s (31% below healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 0.0 s (100% below healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.38 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 374 W·min/l (2% below healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.5 % (4% below healthy). Minor drop in delivered flow relative to motor power indicates early internal pump leakage.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 12.2 bar (74% below healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
